OMV as employer

At OMV, we drive energy, mobility, and lifestyles forward every day. We're working towards becoming an integrated chemicals, fuels and energy company by 2030, and climate neutral by 2050.

Put simply? That means reinventing everyday essentials.

And that takes the best and brightest minds.

This is a place where you can be ambitious.

Feel included and drive innovation. A place that celebrates big thinking, and creates exciting opportunities to learn and grow.

We're calling on people who turn ideas into action.

To become part of a place that celebrates purpose. To contribute to global change by being here.

The best thing about tomorrow is that you can create it. 1 6-Month Internship in People & Culture "By applying to this pool position, you can explore multiple internship opportunities within the business area. We assess your background and connect you with the department that best matches your profile."

What you will learn

 * Support with national and international People & Culture projects and personnel strategy.

 * Prepare reports and presentations relating to relevant People & Culture topics.

 * Support developing new People & Culture concepts.

 * Assist with the process of People & Culture administration.

 * Daily business operations according to the focus of the respective People & Culture department (Recruiting, Compensation & Benefits, Operational HR Management, Talent Management etc.).

What we are looking for

 * Currently studying Human Resource Management, Business Administration or International Management and you want to gain practical experience. 

 * Analytical skills and creative mindset. 

 * Microsoft Office is a walk in the park for you.

 * Team-oriented and proactive mindset.

 * You are fluent in English, German advantageous.

Unlock your potential. Make it count.

Together, we'll reinvent everyday essentials. Join us on our journey of transformation, where you can contribute to a long-lasting legacy.

We offer a dynamic and inclusive environment where your potential can thrive. Join us and become part of a team that's shaping a more sustainable future.

The support contribution will be between € 1.100,- and € 1.400,- monthly, depending on your level of education.

Furthermore you will benefit from our canteen with healthy meal options at great prices and exclusive networking events.

At OMV, you matter. Ready to grow?

At OMV, we're passionate about creating an inclusive environment where everyone has the chance to grow and thrive. We embrace diversity in all its forms - whether it's age, gender identity, disability, ethnicity, religion, or sexual orientation - because we know it makes us stronger.

Our success comes from working together as a diverse team and maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Guided by our values - We Care, We're Curious, We Progress - we're shaping a more sustainable future together.

We're especially proud of our efforts to advance women within our organization. In alignment with our strategy 2030 we are focusing on getting 30% women in management and senior leadership positions.

Therefore you will experience excellent learning opportunities that will subsequently help you to unleash your potential.

Together, Forward for good.

DHL Air (Austria) GmbH is a cargo airline founded in 2021 and a proud subsidiary of the DHL Group. Our primary focus is operating within the European network with a modern fleet of Boeing 757 and 767 aircraft.

Our headquarter is located in Vienna, with our main crew base in Leipzig, where we deliver on our customer promise: Excellence. Simply Delivered.

Would you like to be part of the world's most international company?

Join a company that pioneered cross-border express delivery in ... 1 Ground Safety Expert (m/f/d) Your Responsibility:
As Ground Safety Expert you`ll own risk management and assurance processes across ground safety, including dangerous goods. You will investigate occurrences, support Safety Risk Evaluations, maintain our Ground Operations hazards register and work closely with Ground Operations, Austro Control and DHL group airlines to keep our ground and cargo operations safe. Reporting to the Senior Supervisor Safety, you will play a visible, hands-on role in a Just Culture safety environment where your analysis and recommendations directly inform how we manage risks.

Your Tasks:
 * Coordinate, investigate and manage ground safety investigations and occurrence reports, assessing risk, identifying root causes and recommending corrective and preventative actions.
 * Prepare, coordinate and facilitate the Ground Safety Action Group and contribute to the Safety Review Board.
 * Maintain and develop the Ground Operations hazard register in close partnership with Ground Operations.
 * Support risk assessments of occurrence reports and contribute to Safety Risk Evaluations on ground safety topics.
 * Own the administration and control of ground safety related reports, SPIs and statistics - spotting trends and following them up with the right people.
 * Represent DHA on ground safety matters with external stakeholders such as Austro Control and DHL group airlines.
 * Be accountable for the quality, integrity and regulatory compliance of the risk data and recommendations you produce, in line with IOSA ISARPs and DHA standards.

Your Qualifications:
 * An undergraduate degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 * 5 years of relevant work experience, including at least 2 years in the aeronautical industry.
 * A dangerous goods training certificate - CAT 10 or similar competency-based DG training preferred.
 * Solid experience with risk management and assurance processes in aviation and familiarity with management systems.
 * Working knowledge of EU aviation safety regulations, AOC operations specifications and operations manual requirements.
 * A sound grasp of statistical principles and confidence working with data and trends.
 * Fluent in English, strong MS Office skills and the interpersonal skills to build effective relationships across the business.
 * The ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and stay composed under pressure.

We Offer:
 * Exciting career opportunities in a dynamic, international aviation environment
 * A modern, newly designed office located directly at Vienna Airport with excellent public transport connections
 * Attractive employee benefits, including airport shopping discounts, access to myID travel, corporate benefits, supported KlimaTicket or parking options, Edenred vouchers, and much more.
 * For this roles, we offer a competitive minimum gross salary of € 4,623 based on full-time employment with the possibility of an adjusted salary depending on your experience and qualification. 
 * In addition, we offer an attractive company bonus scheme.
 * This position is initially offered on a two-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of transitioning to a permanent position thereafter.

We are a deep-tech company that creates and produces internationally awarded smart glasses. Our headquarters is in Vienna, where we develop and manufacture both the hardware and the software of the smart glasses.

From research & development, engineering, production to marketing and sales - we offer everything from a single source under one roof. This will give you exciting insights into other departments of the company. Although we have our roots in Austria, we are "born global" and work with customers and sales partners all over the world.

Making Future Reality together - are you in? 1 Assembly Technician (m/f/x) - The Craft Hand Vienna 1010, fulltime

We build award-winning smart glasses in Vienna: hardware, firmware, software, all under one roof. Behind every device that ships is precise, careful, hands-on work, and that's exactly what this role is about. You'll be part of the team that turns components into finished products, working closely with engineers, quality assurance, and production to keep things moving and the standards high.

This is a role where your hands-on skill and attention to detail make a visible difference every single day.

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

 * Hands-on assembly of components and devices across different stages of the production process

 * Material preparation, pre-assembly, cleaning, packaging, and warehouse support

 * Use hand and power tools to assemble products with precision and care

 * Inspect components and assemblies to ensure quality standards are met

 * Document and report any discrepancies in the assembly process

 * Collaborate with team members to meet production deadlines

 * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

 * Completed technical apprenticeship, ongoing or recently completed HTL, or relevant studies

 * Solid technical understanding and careful handling of small components and electronics

 * Manual dexterity and good hand-eye coordination

 * Familiarity with assembly processes, tools, and techniques

 * Attention to detail and a practical problem-solving mindset

 * Flexibility to support a wide range of tasks in production

 * Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

 * Good communication skills in German and/or English

Benefits

What's extra?

 * Salary: €2.400 - €4.000 gross/month depending on experience

 * Yearly public transport card (Vienna)

 * "Inspire Days" - time to learn and recharge

 * A front-row seat to how a deep-tech hardware product gets built, from PCB to shipped device

 * International team where your impact is visible every day

Ready to be part of the team that makes smart glasses real?

We can't wait to meet you.

Making Future Reality - let's assemble it together.

Send us your application and let's take off together!
